1.consolidated_definition: Es preciso saber callar discretamente, sin divulgar lo que se ve y se oye. “¿No se acuelda que me disía: cuando veas una cosa, mírala y cáyate? Vel, oil y cayal.” Meléndez Muñoz.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
It is essential to know how to remain discreetly silent, without divulging what one sees and hears. "When you see something, look at it and fall silent." Meléndez Muñoz.

Translation:
To be aware of the need for discretion in keeping quiet, without revealing what one observes and perceives.
